record_title: A three-nonterminal counterexample to a context-free group-inclusion criterion
provenance: Scientific sources and verification evidence are listed in RESULT.md and REVIEW.md.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The result is a counterexample to the published Theorem 4.3 and Algorithm 4.4 under the literal definition U=Sigma^* x T; it does not rule out a modified construction that quotients or tests the first coordinate in the group. Informal or poorly indexed prior observations remain a residual risk. No independent validation is asserted.
